svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 280 mm long; square both ends to the side faces and file

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them flat. The cap flanges seat on these end faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File a 1 mm x 45 degree lead-in chamfer round the inside of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each end, so the O-ring slides in without being cut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure the bore at both ends (about 146.05 x 44.45 mm) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: write it down: the cap plates are cut to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Radial screw holes: twelve 5.5 mm, 7.76 mm in from each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the top and the bottom wall, at 34.45, 84.45 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 134.45 mm from the front face (between the fins).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill them 4.2 mm first with the caps in place (see the caps).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every edge and hole inside and out; clean, etch-prime

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the outside (not the bore) before the fins are bonded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bore is clean and round-cornered; ends square.
